seoDescription: 64 construction, trades & field service use cases on monday.com, 4 with AI. See the process, boards, automations and integrations for each.
heading: Construction, trades & field service use cases
intro: Every use case comes from a real Fruition client engagement, with the client's name withheld. Select "See the build" for the process diagram, boards, automations and integrations.

faq.question: What do construction, trades & field service organisations build on monday.com with Fruition?
faq.answer: This page shows 64 construction, trades & field service use cases. The most common are work & project management (55), integrations & migration (42), operations & ERP (41), most often for operations & delivery, sales & CRM, projects & PMO teams.

faq.question: How long does a construction, trades & field service monday.com build take?
faq.answer: The most common timeframe for a complete construction, trades & field service build is 6 to 12 months. Phased programs run longer, with later phases added once the core build is adopted.

faq.question: Which systems do construction, trades & field service builds integrate with?
faq.answer: The integrations that come up most often in construction, trades & field service use cases are Xero, Make, SharePoint, Microsoft Outlook, Outlook, Pipedrive.

faq.question: Does Fruition build AI agents for construction, trades & field service?
faq.answer: Yes. 4 of the construction, trades & field service use cases on this page include an AI step. Examples: Uploaded supplier invoices → monday AI column extracts total amount, rolled up per job; Emails to the aftercare inbox → tickets auto-created (Outlook integration with monday AI); AI column extracts inbound job emails and classifies new job vs update vs no action, assigning owner (proposed; make.com for complex parsing).
